x-enum-descriptions.resolved_partial_refund: Dispute resolved with a partial refund.
x-enum-descriptions.resolved_goodwill_refund: Dispute resolved with a goodwill refund.

previousStatus.description: The status the order moved from. `null` for the order's very first status.

reason.description: Why the status changed, when one applies (e.g. a cancellation or dispute reason). `null` otherwise.

shippingManagedByCardNexus.description: `true` when CardNexus manages shipping on this order: the buyer paid CardNexus for the shipping, and the seller ships with a label generated on CardNexus. `false` when the seller ships the order themselves. Set when the order is placed: a later change to the seller's shipping setting only applies to new orders.

shippingService.description: The shipping the buyer paid for. `tracked` ships with a tracking number. `untracked` ships as a letter, which may have no tracking number.

x-enum-descriptions.tracked: The order ships with a tracking number.
x-enum-descriptions.untracked: The order ships as a letter, which may have no tracking number.

anyOf.description: An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. `2024-08-14T10:23:11.000Z`.

untrackedCloseAt.description: When this untracked order closes on its own: it completes and the seller is paid, unless a dispute is opened before then. `null` on tracked orders, and until an untracked order ships.

anyOf.description: Your own key/value pairs on this sale. Empty when you haven't set any. Keys start with a letter and may contain letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, up to 64 characters; values are strings of up to 500 characters. A sale holds at most 50 keys. The buyer never sees them.

metadata.description: Your own metadata on the sale, as it stands after the change — so you can match the order to your own records without a follow-up call. `null` on the buyer's copy: metadata belongs to the seller alone.

data.description: The order's new status and where it moved from.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when you receive a chat message (from the other party, or from CardNexus support). Metadata only — no message text; fetch the conversation to read it. `data.context` is a discriminated union keyed on `type`; today it is always `order`, and new conversation types are added there without breaking your integration.

eventId.description: Idempotency key. Stable across retries of the same delivery; safe to dedupe on.

timestamp.description: When this webhook was emitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

threadId.description: Opaque identifier for the conversation the message belongs to. Treat it as a stable token — don't parse it.

orderNumber.description: The order the conversation is attached to.

scope.description: `main` is your conversation with the other party; `support` is your conversation with CardNexus support.

x-enum-descriptions.main: The order's main conversation between buyer and seller.

x-enum-descriptions.seller: You received this because you're the seller.
x-enum-descriptions.buyer: You received this because you're the buyer.

context.description: What the conversation is about. Always `type: "order"` today; switch on `context.type` so new conversation types added later don't break your integration.

username.description: The handle of whoever sent the message. CardNexus support appears as `cardnexus_support`.

hasAttachments.description: Whether the message carries one or more attachments.

data.description: Who sent the message and which conversation it belongs to.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when a setting on your account changes. `data.changedFields` lists the fields that changed, as paths into the `GET /v1/account/me` response, and the payload carries their new values. Covers `seller.shippingManagedByCardNexus`: whether CardNexus manages shipping on your new sales.

eventId.description: Idempotency key. Stable across retries of the same delivery; safe to dedupe on.

timestamp.description: When this webhook was emitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

x-enum-descriptions.seller.shippingManagedByCardNexus: Whether CardNexus manages shipping on your new sales changed.

changedFields.description: The fields that changed, as paths into the `GET /v1/account/me` response. More fields can be added to this list over time; ignore the ones you don't recognise.

shippingManagedByCardNexus.description: `true` when CardNexus now manages shipping on your new sales: the buyer pays CardNexus for the shipping, and you ship with a label generated on CardNexus. `false` when you now ship your sales yourself. Orders placed before the change keep the value they were placed with.

seller.description: Your seller settings after the change, with the same field names as `seller` on `GET /v1/account/me`.

updatedAt.description: When the change was made.

data.description: What changed on your account, and the new values.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when your wallet balance changes — after a sale, a payout, or a refund. Carries the new `available` and `pending` amounts.

eventId.description: Idempotency key. Stable across retries of the same delivery; safe to dedupe on.

timestamp.description: When this webhook was emitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

amount.description: Decimal amount in the currency's major unit (e.g. `5.23` for €5.23). 2 decimal places for EUR/USD/GBP/CHF/CAD/AUD.

available.description: Funds available to be paid out to your bank account.

amount.description: Decimal amount in the currency's major unit (e.g. `5.23` for €5.23). 2 decimal places for EUR/USD/GBP/CHF/CAD/AUD.

pending.description: Funds from recent sales still clearing, not yet available to pay out.

updatedAt.description: When this balance was last refreshed from the payment processor.

data.description: Your wallet balance after the change.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when the quantity on one or more of your inventory lines changes — after a sale, an order cancellation, an import, a direct edit, or a listing operation. Each delivery carries up to 500 changed lines; larger change sets are split across several deliveries, each with its own `eventId`.

eventId.description: Idempotency key. Stable across retries of the same delivery; safe to dedupe on. When a change set is split across several deliveries, each delivery has its own eventId.

timestamp.description: When this webhook was emitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

reason.description: What caused the change. `order` — a sale reduced your stock. `order_cancelled` — a cancelled order put stock back. `import` — a bulk import ran. `edit` — your inventory was edited directly. `listing` — a listing operation changed quantities.

x-enum-descriptions.order_cancelled: A cancelled order put stock back.

customId.description: Your own identifier for this line, if you've set one. `null` otherwise.

productId.description: The catalogue product this line stocks.

before.description: Quantity on the line before the change.

after.description: Quantity on the line after the change.

changes.description: One entry per inventory line whose quantity changed. Lines whose quantity stayed the same are not included. Each delivery carries up to 500 entries; larger change sets arrive as several deliveries.

data.description: The quantity changes and what caused them.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when one of your inventory import jobs finishes, whether it completed or failed. Includes per-row counts and, when there is one, a link to the error report.

eventId.description: Idempotency key. Stable across retries of the same delivery; safe to dedupe on.

timestamp.description: When this webhook was emitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

jobId.description: The import job's unique identifier, as returned when you started the import.

total.description: Total number of rows in the file you submitted.

failed.description: Rows that could not be imported.

errorReportUrl.description: A time-limited link to a report describing the rows that could not be imported. `null` when every row succeeded.

jobId.description: The import job's unique identifier, as returned when you started the import.

status.description: The import job failed — the file could not be processed.

total.description: Total number of rows in the file you submitted.

failed.description: Rows that could not be imported.

errorReportUrl.description: Always `null`: a failed import produces no row report.

data.description: The finished import job. `status` tells the two shapes apart: a `completed` job carries per-row counts and, when rows failed, an error-report link; a `failed` job carries a `null` report link.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when one of your inventory export jobs finishes. A completed export includes a time-limited download link for the file.

eventId.description: Idempotency key. Stable across retries of the same delivery; safe to dedupe on.

timestamp.description: When this webhook was emitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

jobId.description: The export job's unique identifier, as returned when you started the export.

downloadUrl.description: A time-limited link to download the exported file. It stops working at `expiresAt`.

jobId.description: The export job's unique identifier, as returned when you started the export.

downloadUrl.description: Always `null`: a failed export produces no file.

expiresAt.description: Always `null`: there is no download link to expire.

data.description: The finished export job. `status` tells the two shapes apart: a `completed` job carries a download link, a `failed` job carries `null` link fields.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when a cart-wizard run finishes successfully. Carries a summary of each option (totals + seller count); fetch `GET /v1/optimizer/runs/{id}` for the full per-seller breakdown.

eventId.description: Idempotency key — stable across delivery retries.

timestamp.description: An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. `2024-08-14T10:23:11.000Z`.

modes.description: The objectives this option satisfies. When two modes produce the same solution, the run returns one option listing both.

amount.description: Decimal amount in the currency's major unit (e.g. `5.23` for €5.23). 2 decimal places for EUR/USD/GBP/CHF/CAD/AUD.

total.description: Grand total the buyer pays.

amount.description: Decimal amount in the currency's major unit (e.g. `5.23` for €5.23). 2 decimal places for EUR/USD/GBP/CHF/CAD/AUD.
Decimal amount in the currency's major unit (e.g. `5.23` for €5.23). 2 decimal places for EUR/USD/GBP/CHF/CAD/AUD.

options.description: Summary of each computed option. Fetch `GET /v1/optimizer/runs/{id}` for the full per-seller breakdown.

unmetCount.description: How many targets could not be fully sourced.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

post.description: Fires when a cart-wizard run fails — for example when full coverage was required but not achievable.

eventId.description: Idempotency key — stable across delivery retries.

timestamp.description: An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, e.g. `2024-08-14T10:23:11.000Z`.

reason.description: Why the run failed, when known.

2XX.description: Acknowledged. Return any 2XX status to ack receipt; non-2XX triggers Svix's retry schedule.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Browse the CardNexus catalogue: list games and their expansions, search or look up individual products, browse a product's Marketplace listings, and resolve marketplace ids to CardNexus products. Product search also reports what is for sale and the cheapest copy that ships to a given country — see [Listing-aware search](https://docs.cardnexus.com/products/listing-aware-search). The [Feeds guide](https://docs.cardnexus.com/feeds) covers the same catalogue as downloadable files.

tags.name: Pricing
tags.description: Read market prices for catalogue products: current prices, price history, and recent sales. See the [Pricing guide](https://docs.cardnexus.com/pricing).

tags.name: Feeds
tags.description: Download the catalogue and price data as bulk files: per-game catalog, expansions, prices, and a catalog changelog. See the [Feeds guide](https://docs.cardnexus.com/feeds).

tags.name: Optimizer
tags.description: Optimize a basket of cards into the cheapest, fewest-seller, or balanced ways to buy them across the marketplace — accounting for each seller's shipping, fees, and VAT. Start a run, poll it for the result, then apply an option to your cart.

tags.name: Offers
tags.description: Send and respond to offers, read proposal history, and restore accepted offers to your cart. See [Offers](https://docs.cardnexus.com/offers).

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: Manage your shopping cart: read it, add listings to it, change quantities, and remove items. Add listings by their `listingId`, from `GET /v1/products/{productId}/listings` or an optimizer run's results.

tags.name: Lines
tags.description: Create, read, update, and delete individual inventory lines, and set their photos. See [Managing lines](https://docs.cardnexus.com/inventory/managing-lines).

tags.name: Bulk operations
tags.description: Import and export inventory files, apply bulk updates, import from Cardmarket, TCGplayer, and TCG Power Tools, and track job progress. See [Bulk operations](https://docs.cardnexus.com/inventory/bulk).

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Manage the tags you attach to inventory lines. See [Tags & locations](https://docs.cardnexus.com/inventory/tags-and-locations).

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: Manage the locations where you keep your stock. See [Tags & locations](https://docs.cardnexus.com/inventory/tags-and-locations).

tags.name: Listings
tags.description: List, publish, reprice, and remove your Marketplace listings. See [Listings](https://docs.cardnexus.com/inventory/listings).

tags.name: Lists
tags.description: Create, read, update, and delete your lists — decks, want lists, and for-sale lists. See the [Lists guide](https://docs.cardnexus.com/lists).

tags.name: List items
tags.description: Add cards to a list, update them, and remove them. See the [Lists guide](https://docs.cardnexus.com/lists).

tags.name: Sales
tags.description: Read and manage the orders where you're the seller: list your sales, fetch a single sale by order number, mark orders shipped, cancel them, refund part of them, and attach your own metadata. See [Track sales in your own system](https://docs.cardnexus.com/recipes/order-metadata).

tags.name: Purchases
tags.description: Read the orders where you're the buyer: list your purchases and fetch a single purchase by order number.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Read the account that owns your API key, check your wallet balance, and turn vacation mode on or off. See [Authentication](https://docs.cardnexus.com/guides/authentication).

tags.name: Connect
tags.description: Complete the account-connection handshake for an integration application: exchange the one-time code from the connect redirect for the account id and the permissions it granted you. See [Building an integration](https://docs.cardnexus.com/guides/integrations).

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: For integration applications with the managed-account privilege: create an account for a seller who isn't on CardNexus yet, then issue a hosted-onboarding link so they can take it live. See [Building an integration](https://docs.cardnexus.com/guides/integrations).

tags.name: Tracking
tags.description: For integration applications with the tracking privilege: send the mail and carrier scans of the labels you printed for sellers who connected your application. See [Building an integration](https://docs.cardnexus.com/guides/integrations).
